optimizedContext.value:
# Symbol Model

## Rules
- `FileNode`: canonical forward-slash `{workspace}:{relativeToCodeRoot}` `path`; project-relative diagnostic path; language, content hash, workspace, optional deferred embedding. Equality by `path`. Optional `namespace` + `namespaceSeparator` co-occur, survive hydration, ignore equality.
- `SpecNode`: identity `specId`; path, title, description, artifact-derived content/hash, ordered `dependsOn`, workspace. Equality by `specId`.
- `SymbolNode`: deterministic `filePath + kind + name + line + column` identity; canonical file path, project-relative path, full construct range, exact `selectionRange`, optional comment. Ranges 1-based lines, 0-based half-open columns; construct non-empty and contains selection.
- Specs, Files, Symbols, Documents use workspace-qualified canonical primary identities.
- Immutable runtime `FileAnalysisDraft`, `FileAnalysis`, `ParserState`, `AdapterSessionState` carry symbols, imports, deterministic binding/call facts, optional `qualifiedReferenceFacts`, namespace context, normalized metadata, run-local identity, compact reusable parser/cache data. Distinct from persistence; no persisted ID/schema changes.
- Optional `qualifiedReferenceFacts`: syntax-only `qualifier.name` evidence with `kind` `call`|`construct`|`type`, optional `sourceSymbolId`, location. Absent≡empty; never alone implies relation/target; resolution owned by `code-graph:language-adapter`.
- Run-scoped lookup: files by canonical path/run ID; symbols by file/simple/qualified name; file↔symbol; specs/documents; spec↔covered symbol; pre-persistence relation dedupe. `IndexSession`/`SymbolIndex` may collaborate.
- Retained parser/session state, facts, imports, indexes = plain immutable data; never retain AST/parser trees/cursors after per-file analysis.
- `DocumentNode`: searchable non-code text; same identity format including reserved `root:`.
- Closed `SymbolKind`: `function`, `class`, `method`, `variable`, `type`, `interface`, `enum`, `property`. File/module state→Variable no `parentId`; routine-local→Variable + routine `parentId`; container state→Property + container `parentId`.
- Closed `RelationType`: `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Equality = source+target+type.
- Hierarchy: type→ancestor `EXTENDS`; type→contract `IMPLEMENTS`; replacing/concretizing method→`OVERRIDES`. Language inheritance-adjacent MAY normalize conservatively.
- `ImportDeclaration`: local/original names, raw specifier, relative flag, optional kind. Side-effect/dynamic/require/Go blank = empty names, no fake symbols; resolve later.
- Immutable scoped facts: scope ownership; source-aware bindings; local/parameter/property/class-managed/inherited/global/imported/framework/constructor/alias sources; free/member/static/constructor calls; caller; deterministic evidence. Scope cycles abort lookup.
- Deterministic facts emit persisted `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Drop self-relations; unresolved = non-persisted diagnostics only. No runtime/reflection/container/interprocedural guessing.
- All model/aggregate props `readonly`; graph mutation only via atomic `GraphStore` replacement.
- `SpecdCodeGraphError extends SpecdError`; package errors: `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `StoreNotOpenError`.
- Logical ≠ physical declaration. Language-proven overload/merge/augmentation MAY group; competing stay distinct. Structured workspace, surface, canonical logical owner, symbol space, simple name, `MemberSemantics`, escaped versioned canonical reference authoritative. Canonical ref includes semantic axes, round-trips, survives location moves; rejects retired single-form encoding.
- Owned logical symbol stores exact dotted `qualified_name`; top-level omits. Not canonical ID, alias row, simple-name replacement, or FTS exact-match surrogate; `::` queries compare as dotted spelling.
- Logical identity carries no package name. `SymbolKind` stays broad; symbol space + member semantics independent. Namespace/module = owner-path role/surface, not `SymbolKind`.
- `declaringOwner` = canonical logical owner, never parser/location/display ID. Adapter establishes owner before members; emits lexical occurrence `parentId`. Same-name under different owners never share identity.
- Three non-bijective layers: physical location-backed `SymbolNode`; scope/range-preserving `LocalBinding`; semantic `LogicalSymbol`. Parameters/receivers/aliases/locals stay bindings unless proven addressable. Unmapped physical decls remain navigation/dependency evidence.
- Multiple decls share logical identity only with positive language grouping evidence; absent/empty/unknown key never groups. Logical target retains deterministic declaration set.
- `MemberSemantics` = `kind`+`dispatch`+`accessor`+optional `nativeKind`; retired `MemberForm` absent. Preserve type/value/namespace-module/property spaces and language-sensitive case; never globally lowercase or collapse differing axes.
- Public binding slot = surface+exported name+symbol space. Each target/ordered re-export route distinct binding identity incl. default/anonymous; never first same-name workspace symbol. Local bindings preserve scope/range; aliases/shadowing/competing routes never collapse via metadata-insensitive relation equality.
- Physical dependency/hierarchy relations authoritative. Logical projection MAY aggregate but retains every declaration, relation, source location. Counts label physical vs logical; unmapped decls = declaration-only evidence.
- `COVERS_SYMBOL` targets `LogicalSymbol.id`; physical traversal projects to logical while retaining declaration locations. Persist per-file/package coverage state + indexed hash for indexed/excluded/unsupported/parse-failed/partial.

## Constraints
- Structural value equality except deterministic `SymbolNode.id`.
- Adding `SymbolKind` or `RelationType` requires spec change.
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`.
- `FileNode.embedding` deferred until embedding pipeline.
- `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL` vocabulary exists but v1.5/v2 processes do not populate it.
- v1.5 indexer populates `DEPENDS_ON` from `.specd-metadata.yaml` or `spec.md`.
- v2 persists `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` for supported languages.
